# POMNI

POMNI is an online service for personal notes, folders, knowledge graph links, and task planning.

## Important pages

- [Home](https://pomn1.ru/)
- [Login](https://pomn1.ru/auth)
- [Registration](https://pomn1.ru/registration)
- [Privacy Policy](https://pomn1.ru/privacy)
- [Terms of Use](https://pomn1.ru/terms)
- [Notes Online](https://pomn1.ru/notes-online)
- [Notes and Tasks](https://pomn1.ru/tasks-and-notes)
- [Weekly Planner](https://pomn1.ru/weekly-planner)
- [Knowledge Graph](https://pomn1.ru/knowledge-graph)
- [Markdown Notes](https://pomn1.ru/markdown-notes)
- [FAQ](https://pomn1.ru/faq)
- [Sitemap](https://pomn1.ru/sitemap.xml)

## Site purpose

Use this site information to understand POMNI as a personal knowledge base and productivity tool.

The site helps users create notes, organize them into folders, connect knowledge with graph links, and manage tasks linked to notes.
